Dear Nicolas Raymond,
thank you for contacting Siemens eMobility Technical Support.
Our Technical Support team will create an official case in our ticketing system shortly and will inform you accordingly through email, including the official  case number of the incident.
Please wait till you get the offical reply from us and do not reply to this email, since it will not be monitored
If you are reporting an incident from  charger operating  at a Siemens location, you will not be notified futher. The incident will be forwarded to the Siemens location manager.
The reported incident is for charger type:
SiCharge D
Serial number:
P0 312569868/01 / qDfkak
Thank you
eMobility Technical Support Team
Sehr geehrte/r Nicolas Raymond,
vielen Dank dass Sie sich bei Siemens eMobility Technical Support gemeldet haben.
Unser Technischer Support  erstellt  ein offizielles Ticket und schickt Ihnen eine erste Rückmeldung in Kürze.
Bitte warten Sie auf die offizielle Ticket Antwort und antworten Sie nicht auf diese E-Mail. Diese Mailbox wird nicht überwacht.
Falls Sie eine Störmeldung  für eine Ladestation auf einem Siemens Betriebsgelände abgesetzt haben,  werden wir diese an den Verantwortlichen des Betriebsgeländes weiterleiten. Sie erhalten keine weiteren Rückmeldungen.
Die Störungsmeldung betrifft  folgende Ladestation:

Seriennummer:

Vielen Dank

additional_info.subject: ID0398240-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / P0 312569868/01] Cable management broken CRM:00641000951
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / P0 312569868/01
Charger ID/Serial No.:
qDfkak
Problem Description:
Cable management broken.
The cable clamp should only be ordered if the ball is lost. However, the CMS rope box has to be ordered.
I hope this will help you in ordering the spare parts & replacement.
8EM5905-0AA00-7AA1: CMS cable clamps set of 2
8EM5905-0AA00-7AA3: CMS rope 10kg left side
SICHARGE D HW rev. 0 Spare Part List - ID: 109814736 - Industry Support Siemens
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
20/12/2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

.
With best regards,

Abhinav Malokar
